verses.en: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
verses.pt: E naquele mesmo tempo estavam ali presentes alguns, que lhe contavam dos galileus cujo sangue Pilatos tinha misturado com seus sacrifícios.
verses.en_web: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
verses.en_bbe: Now some people who were there at that time, gave him an account of how the blood of some Galilaeans had been mixed by Pilate with their offerings.

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?
verses.pt: E respondendo Jesus, disse-lhes: Vós pensais que estes galileus foram mais pecadores, por terem sofrido estas coisas?
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?
verses.en_bbe: And he, in answer, said to them, Are you of the opinion that these Galilaeans were worse than all other Galilaeans, because these things were done to them?

verses.en: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
verses.pt: Não, eu vos digo; antes, se vós não vos arrependerdes, todos de modo semelhante perecereis.
verses.en_web: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.
verses.en_bbe: I say to you, It is not so: but if your hearts are not changed, you will all come to the same end.

verses.en: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
verses.pt: Ou aqueles dezoito, sobre os quais a torre em Siloé caiu, matando-os; pensais que eram mais culpados dos que todos as pessoas que moravam em Jerusalém?
verses.en_web: Or those eighteen, on whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them; do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?
verses.en_bbe: Or those eighteen men who were crushed by the fall of the tower of Siloam, were they worse than all the other men living in Jerusalem?

verses.en: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
verses.pt: Não, eu vos digo; antes, se vós não vos arrependerdes, todos de modo semelhante perecereis.
verses.en_web: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”
verses.en_bbe: I say to you, It is not so: but if your hearts are not changed, you will all come to an end in the same way.

verses.en: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
verses.pt: E dizia esta parábola: Um certo homem tinha uma figueira plantada em sua vinha, e veio até ela para buscar fruto, e não achou.
verses.en_web: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and found none.
verses.en_bbe: And he made up this story for them: A certain man had a fig-tree in his garden, and he came to get fruit from it, and there was no fruit.

verses.en: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
verses.pt: E disse ao que cuidava da vinha: Eis que há três anos, que venho para buscar fruto nesta figueira, e não o acho; corta-a; por que ainda ocupa inutilmente a terra?
verses.en_web: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down. Why does it waste the soil?’
verses.en_bbe: And he said to the gardener, See, for three years I have been looking for fruit from this tree, and I have not had any: let it be cut down; why is it taking up space?

verses.en: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
verses.pt: E respondendo ele, disse-lhe: Senhor, deixa-a ainda este ano, até que eu a escave ao redor, e a adube;
verses.en_web: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it, and fertilize it.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Lord, let it be for this year, and I will have the earth turned up round it, and put animal waste on it, to make it fertile:

verses.en: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.
verses.pt: E se der fruto, deixa-a ficar; se não, tu a cortarás depois.
verses.en_web: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”
verses.en_bbe: And if, after that, it has fruit, it is well; if not, let it be cut down.

verses.en: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
verses.pt: E ensinava em uma das sinagogas num sábado.
verses.en_web: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
verses.en_bbe: And he was teaching in one of the Synagogues on the Sabbath.

verses.en: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.
verses.pt: E eis que estava ali uma mulher, que havia dezoito anos que tinha um espírito de enfermidade; e andava encurvada, e de maneira nenhuma ela podia se endireitar.
verses.en_web: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bent over, and could in no way straighten herself up.
verses.en_bbe: And there was a woman who had had a disease for eighteen years; she was bent, and was not able to make herself straight.

verses.en: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
verses.pt: E Jesus vendo-a, chamou-a para si, e disse-lhe: Mulher, livre estás de tua enfermidade.
verses.en_web: When Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”
verses.en_bbe: And when Jesus saw her, he said to her, Woman, you are made free from your disease.

verses.en: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
verses.pt: E pôs as mãos sobre ela, e logo ela se endireitou, e glorificava a Deus.
verses.en_web: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight, and glorified God.
verses.en_bbe: And he put his hands on her, and she was made straight, and gave praise to God.

verses.en: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
verses.pt: E o chefe da sinagoga, irritado por Jesus ter curado no sábado, respondendo, disse à multidão: Há seis dias em que se deve trabalhar; nestes dias, pois, vinde para ser curados, e não no dia de sábado.
verses.en_web: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”
verses.en_bbe: And the ruler of the Synagogue was angry because Jesus had made her well on the Sabbath, and he said to the people, There are six days in which men may do work: so come on those days to be made well, and not on the Sabbath.

verses.en: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
verses.pt: Porém o Senhor lhe respondeu, e disse: Hipócrita, no sábado cada um de vós não desata seu boi ou jumento da manjedoura, e o leva para dar de beber?
verses.en_web: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath, and lead him away to water?
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord gave him an answer and said, O you false men! do you not, every one of you, on the Sabbath, let loose his ox and his ass and take it to the water?

verses.en: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?
verses.pt: E não convinha soltar desta ligadura no dia de sábado a esta mulher,que é filha de Abraão, a qual, eis que Satanás já a havia ligado há dezoito anos?
verses.en_web: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”
verses.en_bbe: And is it not right for this daughter of Abraham, who has been in the power of Satan for eighteen years, to be made free on the Sabbath?

verses.en: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
verses.pt: E ele, dizendo estas coisas, todos seus adversários ficaram envergonhados; e todo o povo se alegrava de todas as coisas gloriosas que eram feitas por ele.
verses.en_web: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed, and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
verses.en_bbe: And when he said these things, those who were against him were shamed, and all the people were full of joy because of the great things which were done by him.

verses.en: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
verses.pt: E dizia: A que o Reino de Deus é semelhante? E a que eu o compararei?
verses.en_web: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?
verses.en_bbe: Then he said, What is the kingdom of God like? what comparison may I make of it?

verses.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
verses.pt: Semelhante é ao grão da mostarda, que um homem, tomando-o, lançou-o em sua horta; e cresceu, e fez-se uma grande árvore, e as aves dos céus fizeram ninhos em seus ramos.
verses.en_web: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and put in his own garden. It grew, and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”
verses.en_bbe: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his garden, and it became a tree, and the birds of heaven made their resting-places in its branches.

verses.en: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
verses.pt: E disse outra vez: A que compararei o Reino de Deus?
verses.en_web: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?
verses.en_bbe: And again he said, What is the kingdom of God like?

verses.en: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.pt: Semelhante é ao fermento, que a mulher, tomando-o, o escondeu em três medidas de farinha, até tudo ficar levedado.
verses.en_web: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
verses.en_bbe: It is like leaven, which a woman put into three measures of meal, and it was all leavened.

verses.en: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
verses.pt: E andava de cidade em cidade, e de aldeia em aldeia ensinando, e caminhando para Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And he went on his way, through towns and country places, teaching and journeying to Jerusalem.

verses.en: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
verses.pt: E disse-lhe um: Senhor, são também poucos os que se salvam? E ele lhes disse:
verses.en_web: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,
verses.en_bbe: And someone said to him, Lord, will only a small number have salvation? And he said to them,

verses.en: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
verses.pt: Trabalhai para entrar pela porta estreita; porque eu vos digo, que muitos procuraram entrar, e não puderam.
verses.en_web: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in, and will not be able.
verses.en_bbe: Do your best to go in by the narrow door, for I say to you, A number will make the attempt to go in, but will not be able to do so.

verses.en: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
verses.pt: Porque quando o chefe da casa se levantar, e fechar a porta, e se estiverdes de fora, e começardes a bater à porta, dizendo: Senhor, senhor, abre-nos! E respondendo ele, vos disser: Não vos conheço, nem sei de onde vós sois.
verses.en_web: When once the master of the house has risen up, and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside, and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’
verses.en_bbe: When the master of the house has got up, and the door has been shut, and you, still outside, give blows on the door, saying, Lord, let us in; he will make answer and say, I have no knowledge of where you come from.

verses.en: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.
verses.pt: Então começareis a dizer: Em tua presença temos comido e bebido, e tens ensinado em nossas ruas.
verses.en_web: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
verses.en_bbe: Then you will say, We have taken food and drink with you, and you were teaching in our streets.

verses.en: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
verses.pt: E ele dirá: Digo-vos que não vos conheço, nem sei de onde vós sois; afastai-vos de mim, vós todos praticantes de injustiça.
verses.en_web: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
verses.en_bbe: But he will say, Truly, I have no knowledge of you or where you come from; go away from me, you workers of evil.

verses.en: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
verses.pt: Ali haverá choro e ranger de dentes, quando virdes a Abraão, a Isaque, a Jacó, e a todos os profetas no Reino de Deus; mas vós sendo lançados fora.
verses.en_web: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets, in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.
verses.en_bbe: There will be weeping and cries of sorrow when you see Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves are shut outside.

verses.en: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
verses.pt: E virão pessoas do oriente, e do ocidente, e do norte, e do sul, e se sentarão à mesa no Reino de Deus.
verses.en_web: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: And they will come from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south, and take their places in the kingdom of God.

verses.en: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
verses.pt: E eis que há alguns dos últimos que serão primeiros, e há alguns dos primeiros que serão últimos.
verses.en_web: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”
verses.en_bbe: And the last will be first, and the first will be last.

verses.en: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
verses.pt: Naquele mesmo dia, chegaram uns fariseus, dizendo-lhe: Sai, e vai-te daqui, porque Herodes quer te matar.
verses.en_web: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here, and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
verses.en_bbe: At that time, certain Pharisees came to him and said, Go away from this place, because Herod's purpose is to put you to death.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
verses.pt: E disse-lhes: Ide, e dizei a aquela raposa: eis que expulso demônios, e faço curas hoje e amanhã, e ao terceiro dia eu terei completado.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Go and say to that fox, I send out evil spirits and do works of mercy today and tomorrow, and on the third day my work will be complete.

verses.en: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Porém é necessário que hoje, e amanhã, e no dia seguinte eu caminhe; porque um profeta não pode morrer fora de Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’
verses.en_bbe: But I have to go on my way today and tomorrow and the third day, for it is not right for a prophet to come to his death outside Jerusalem.

verses.en: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!
verses.pt: Jerusalém, Jerusalém, que matas aos profetas, e apedrejas aos que te são enviados: quantas vezes eu quis juntar teus filhos, como a galinha junta seus pintos debaixo de suas asas, e não quisestes?
verses.en_web: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!
verses.en_bbe: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, putting to death the prophets, and stoning those who were sent to her! again and again would I have taken your children to myself, as a bird takes her young ones under her wings, but you would not!

verses.en: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.pt: Eis que vossa casa é deixada deserta para vós. E em verdade vos digo, que não me vereis até que venha o tempo em que digais: Bendito aquele que vem no nome do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
verses.en_bbe: Now see, your house is waste, and I say to you, You will not see me again till you say, A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord.
